title: Allergic reaction to this!
date: Reviewed in the United States on 1 June 2021
review: I love so many other Isdin products but not this one.  It arrived broken and oozing out of the plastic bag.  This turned out to be lucky for me.  It got on my hands and caused terrible itching and burning.  I am chemically sensitive to the scent chemicals but did not expect them to be in this product.  I am thankful it didn't arrive intact or I may have used it all over my body before realizing that I am allergic.  Aloe Vera seems so skin friendly, I was not expecting the smell or the irritation.

title: overwhelming aloe vera scent
date: Reviewed in the United States on 29 October 2020
review: I was a little disappointed with this hand/body wash because I thought it was a product for very sensitive skin. Luckily I don’t have super sensitive skin but I tend to use products that are on the gentler side, which is why I like the stuff for people with sensitive skin/babies.Right out of the bottle I thought the scent, which I had expected a very light aloe vera smell, was overwhelming. I have plenty of scented soaps and things but even this was too much! It was way too much scent especially for a product that is meant for sensitive skin. People who use sensitive soap generally do not like heavily scented and this product is definitely heavily scented, even if it is aloe vera smell. Second, looking at the ingredients list I am confused as to why there is coloring added to this product when the soap is a clear gel.Overall I do not like this product but I don’t like to waste products so I will finish using it (will probably dilute it because of the overwhelming scent). It might work for some people but I just did not like it.
